technology_name: PGPR Talc Formulation for Seed Spices
problem_solved: Limited availability of microbial growth-promoting inputs for seed spices
description: Talc-based PGPR formulation developed for seed spice cultivation. The formulation enables application of beneficial microorganisms to support crop growth and agricultural productivity.
applications:
Agricultural bio-input and microbial inoculant manufacturers
Seed spice cultivation enterprises (coriander, cumin, fennel, etc.)
Organic farming and sustainable agriculture initiatives
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and spice grower cooperatives
Agricultural input companies and crop productivity enhancement programs
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
